reviews.comment: Dude is extremely chill and GOATED, but your grade heavily depends on which TA you get since they're the ones who actually grade your ILNs. You're either going to be the happiest or most depressed individual after final grades come out.

Some people liked him, but I found him arrogant. Fair tests but would include things he said weren't important. Homeworks long but easy. Points just for coming to class. Worst part was his lectures: spent little time working through concepts and explaining and more time on real world applications and funny stories. Fair class and easily doable.

Worst professor ever, it is one thing to weed out kids in a difficult course, and it is another to purposely tell TAs to deflate grades. Can't believe I turned down UCLA and UT for this, even a full ride here would not have made this worth it. Good luck to A&M not being looked at like a joke with people like this running the show

Even the smartest students struggled because of him physically telling TA's to downgrade lab assignments (Saw a text of him saying this to a TA). Made lab exam so difficult for no reason. Everyone I know struggled. DO WELL ON LAB ASSIGNMENTS SO YOU'RE NOT SCARED AT END OF SEMESTER, GO TO YOUR TA'S OFFICE HOURS. GL.

This man should not have a career in chemistry in any way, shape, or form. Lee sucked every joy of chem lab out of my life since I got to this school 2 years ago. The TAs he has working for him are forced to take points off for no reason or face job loss. If I could sign a petition for his immediate removal, I would.

He should be fired immediately. He is such a terrible person, makes lab uncoordinated and way too messy. The TAs are overworked and the students are targeted to do bad. He likes to make things as hard as possible and then sit back and watch the show unfold. Terrible human. TAs are forced to gatekeep or else he takes points from THEIR grades.

He hates talking to students and responds to questions in a condescending and rude manner. He phrases replies to questions to be unhelpful as possible. His TA's are forced to average all of their students' assignment grades to a 70 or they get fired (it happened). How is this insanely unethical practice and horrible professor even allowed at A&M???

Amazes me how a school as large as A&M can have a guy like this running something as important as an Organic Chemistry Lab program. Least understanding professor I have ever spoken to; a bit of a demeaning tone towards students even in one on one office hour settings. He would be better off in a lab setting not revolved around students. Don't take.
How is he leading this class or any class in general? Worst teacher I've had at TAMU. He doesn't care about anything, borderline hate students. Ochem is already painful avoid him !!!

Best CHEM prof I've ever had. Made OCHEM seem easy and understandable. Does use iClicker for attendance but no geographic radius so can technically do from home. Definitely should go to lectures, he is interactive and goes in depth on the slides he posts. HW is online, usually 30~ questions per chapter, but have 10 tries per question. Reviews exams

Professor Edward Lee is one of the most challenging professors I've had at TAMU, but not in a positive way. His lectures are often disorganized, making it hard to follow the material or understand key concepts. Would not recommend he creates an environment of poor learning.
This was the worst experience I had ever had. Do not take this guy.

Dr. Lee is an incredible professor. Coming from someone with little CHEM experience, I would say this was a great course. Class isn't difficult if you put in the effort and study! He genuinely cares about his students and is always joking during his lectures. iClicker involvement for points! I recommend going to class; it will greatly benefit you!

Edward Lee is one of the best CHEM I've had. Attendance is not technically mandatory and he posts all lectures online, but I highly recommend being in person. Minimal work assigned outside of class besides studying on your own. No official extra credit but his exams are out of 120pts, but puts the x/120 out of 100 which massively boosts your grade.

Lee should not be the head of ochem 1 lab. The lab is coordinated terribly. Cannot blame the TAs for the way they grade because I know they have to follow guidelines. But lab is so unorganized, nothing is clear, and your left on your own. You'll get a bad grade no matter how hard you try. Never had a worse experience with a lab than this one.
. He truly does not care about his students and is inflexible when it comes to making accommodations. I have never come across such a demeaning professor in my career.

I absolutely loved Dr. Lee! It was his first semester teaching 222 and he made it as understandable as possible. Like, I nearly failed gen chem but got a 100 in this class. Lots of bonus points on quizzes, posts lectures and reviews on Canvas, and homework is pretty straightforward. Does do clicker questions though, beware of that!

Dr. Lee loves to teach and that is evident in all of his lectures. He cares about his students and responds very quickly to answer questions. He gave reviews that were similar to material on the tests, and hosted review sessions that went over the reviews. Ochem is not an easy class, but Dr. Lee made it enjoyable.

Lee is a great professor who cares about his students. Go over the test reviews well as they help greatly on the exams. His lectures are recorded as well but attendance is mandatory. Sometimes I wish his notes lined up a bit more with what is on tests, but going to office hours greatly helps with homework and exam grades.

This class is insanely hard, but Dr. Lee is a great professor. iClicker participation is done throughout the semester, but you only need 75% to get full marks, so attendance isn't required. Lots of homework, but as long as you complete all the assignments and study a good amount for the exams, you will pass.

I had Lee for his first ever time teaching, which certainly means that he has room for improvement. But I took OChem, which is not easy. Although you could tell he was a first time prof, he still did a good job of explaining the material and was happy to answer any questions. I can tell that with practice he'll be great. Iclicker and regular HW.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great Professor. He takes his time teaching and uploads the class to canvas. The homework on OWL isn't hard or too much either. And actually, is really helpful for the tests. His problem sets (study guide) for the tests aren't similar to the tests but they help to make sure you know the basics.

Good guy, not the best professor in general terms. If I did not go out of my way to get help in his office hours or study a bunch, would not have passed. The test reviews were not like the tests, making the averages pretty low on tests throughout the semester. However, he did drop the cutoff a lot to accommodate for the low average.

Not a bad guy, just a bad prof. During lectures he goes slow for easy stuff and rushes through difficult/ important material. The exam reviews given are super different from the actual tests, you're better off using OWL to review. He uses iClicker to take attendance which is an easy way to raise your grade. I survived by tutoring and a study group.

GOAT Lee is a great prof for CHEM107. His lectures can be hard to follow at times but he uploads them to make studying easier. He gave us multiple extra credit opportunities and helped us out as much as possible. Don't miss lectures and attend the S.I reviews and you will succeed in the class.

Overall, Dr. Lee was a decent professor. His exams for CHEM 107 were very hard, so you must study a lot outside of class or get tutoring in order to be successful. Dr. Lee was very generous at the end of the course by curving the class grades and adjusting cut-offs to help students be successful. Study and work hard and you should pass.

If you are not already great at chemistry the lectures will be super confusing and not helpful. The only form of studying for the test is old assignments and a TA review that is nothing like the test.

Dr. Lee loves chemistry and that rubs off on his students. His Power Points can be hard to follow at times but it is easy to catch yourself and even in large classes he manages to make everyone feel confident. Awesome professor!

I had Dr. Lee for 107 and I don't understand the bad reviews. I was dreading chem because I wasn't a student that took AP Chem in high school but the concepts were fairly easy to understand as long as you stay on top of it. His lectures are fine to understand, I made a bunch of flashcards in Anki directly from his lectures/homework and did well.

107/117-I quite literally could not recommend a professor less. Cool dude, but his class structure and lazily designed lectures are completely ridiculous. Total lack of care and communication. Spends most of class on overexplaining easy concepts, and ignoring hard ones. Also does NOT communicate withn updates on grading or go over exams well.

Dr. Lee is an amazing professor. I found the class pretty easy but there is A LOT of homework so be prepared for that. As long as you stay on top of lectures and homework, you should be able to get an A. There was only a midterm and final so they were weighted pretty heavy. He is so funny and you can really tell he cares about his students!

Dr. Lee really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He uses reverse classroom, so get ready to watch a couple of hours of lecture before class each week. I never studied or watched lecture for this class and was able to get a B by going to A+ reviews once a week. With a little effort, an A is achievable.
The best most understanding professor i have ever had. He explains things in his lectures really well so make sure to watch the videos before class.

Dr. Lee is an amazing professor for CHEM 119. He is very understanding and helpful and gives you fair chances to get a good grade in his class. Make sure to balance the homework load, watch the posted lectures before class, and participate in REEF to be successful in this class.

Chemistry is hard no matter who you take it with and for most people, myself included, CHEM 119 is NOT an easy A class. However, I could not have imagined a better professor to take this class with than Dr. Lee. He explains things really well and remains extremely patient will ALL student questions. He made CHEM 119 enjoyable, despite all the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is a lot of homework but it is doable. He is understanding, don't be afraid to ask for help. His lectures are hilarious. Watch pre-lectures and you will do great in his class. Pay attention when using reef since it is part of your grade. Exams are not hard but they require a bit of work. Overall, he is a great choice.

You won't have any interaction with Lee at all, only your TA . This class is an absolute nightmare. Grading is so absurdly late and they don't do grade boundaries (70/80/90), so you literally won't know if you're failing on acing until they submit grades at the end of semester. Worst class I've taken during my first semester here.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Lee is one of the most caring and respectful professors I have had so far. Not only does he want for his students to succeed and understand the material, he values the students' mental health as well. Though there is a ton of work assigned for lecture and lab combined, the lectures resemble a review session. Absolutely recommend!

The only evidence I have that this prof exists is the two emails he sent out all semester. Completely TA led. So just hope you don't get a strict TA. Even with the class over a week ago, grades are still not in. Assignments are not extremely difficult but very harshly graded. Overall though just do your work and show up to labs and you should pass.

Professor Lee is an AWESOME professor. He is honestly one of the best professors I've had at A&M so far, and I recommend taking him for any chemistry courses if you have the chance. Not only is he a great teacher, but he is also just a really genuine and caring guy who wants his students to succeed. Awesome guy.

Amazing professor, super understanding. Flipped classroom so stay on top of lectures. Material on quizzes/exams was easier than what was taught in class/homework. Super happy with my choice to take him.
Professor Lee was a great professor. He cared for his students and stressed mental health. It was a challenging class but professor Lee made it more enjoyable

Professor Lee cares a lot about his students and stresses mental health. He works with his students and is very patient. I took this class on Zoom and he was quick to answer questions that popped up in the chat. You must attend class to get attendance credit. Had to watch recorded lecture before class, and in class we went over practice problems.

I'm not sure why he has a low rating. I have him for covid virtual chem - he is super caring and accessible - he is willing to clarify questions/when youre stuck. very relateable person. lectures can be a little hard to follow since he skips through the boring stuff but you can ask questions. he replaced my old prof but im glad i got him.

I LOVE HIM. Best chem prof by far. I did pretty well in chem in high school so I cant judge difficulty but the class - if you did your homework on ur own time- was really easy. We do a lot of practice during lecture for points and he honestly would bump a grade if u work hard. Highly recommend him!!

I took this class with very little science background and learned a lot. Dr. Lee is very upfront about what the coursework will be like and was very flexible with changing homework due dates. Dr. Lee posts the lecture material to watch the day before the scheduled lecture so that during class he can do practice questions similar to tests and hw.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: TA led. My TA was awesome, I enjoyed lab, she was funny and always stopped to make sure the class was all caught up and waited until everyone was ready to continue. I heard from other classes Lee is the best, so I recommend him.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I haven't heard of anyone whos contacted him, except for one myth floating around that someone managed to get to him but nothing happened out of that interaction. The class is completely handled by TA's and they barely know what's going on because it seems like Dr. Lee also leaves them in the dark. Also, has little to no correlation w/ lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: CHEM 117 during Fall Semester. Prof Lee determines the assignments and grading procedure. The main portion of the course to done through the TA. Be very careful taking each assignment. Grading is done by a certain percentage of the class getting an A. Scoring above 90% is not applicable for A. Do the work assigned to be successful in this course!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Does not contact students at all. Whole class is handled by your TA. Expects perfection in all assignments and will always take off points for every miniscule mistake. Grading criteria is not given so you have no idea what the TA expects. Grading curve is not given so you have no idea what grade you will receive. Horrible experience overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Really unclear what we needed to do for each experiment, so we often ended up doing postlab questions that weren't required because he left them in the lab slides. My TA never answered any of my (7) emails, but when I emailed Lee, he just sent a sarcastic/ rude, yet still unhelpful reply. No feedback was given on grades for labs. Kind of a jerk.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I've never met this professor, but he is not the best. He hires TA's that do not speak English. I hate to say it, but its true. This is not only my class. He is very confusing on what he expects, I went through most of class not knowing what to do, even if you ask. 1 hour credit class, but had to work hardest for it. Very tough graders.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I actually never interacted with Dr. Lee. This lab is run by TA's. Expect this 1 hour class to have 3-4 hours of homework per week. I've heard some bad things if you interact or challenge Dr. Lee, but never met the man. The TA's have a help desk if you get stuck. Make sure you properly format your graphs and memorize how to!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Super chill professor just pay attention and you'll get an A
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee offers students chances to participate in class which helps to cement chemistry knowledge. The online version of CHEM 119 requires one to watch lectures ahead of time, but it allows for interaction during class. Dr. Lee is very inspirational and would totally take again! He also offers many opportunities to bring your grade up.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is very unaccommodating and rude when interacting with students. When he is not insulting them and their personal intelligence, he is making it a point that his students are at the mercy of him and his TAs who don't even know how to conduct the examples. If you get a 60 on the first lab, and don't get any feedback, you will get 60s on all.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Everyone's experience is different because we had different TAs. Personally, when I had an issue about my grade, Lee was quick to respond and fixed my issue. That said, online + lab is an organizational nightmare. Instructions were unclear, grading was slow, some assignments were confusing, and missing a class makes your grade go down a letter.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Edward Lee is by far the worst professor I had this semester. The whole CHEM 117 online system is awful. Be prepared to not be a second late or your grade will be .5 of what it would normally be. For a 1 credit hour class, this is the most work I have done. He is impossible to reach and relies heavily on his TA hierarchy to do everything. Awful.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Labs were run by the TAs. Although Lee probably set up all the labs, the TAs just play a video of the lab being conducted and you write down observations. Keep in mind this was an online class because of Covid. Also your letter grade does not decide your grade in this class. It's graded on a distribution. Lab assignments are not hard, but tedious

Professor Lee was a really great way to start chemistry. The things people are complaining about on here most of the time are out of his control and he doesn't like either. Our homework website sucks, but you use the same one no matter which professor you have. Dr. Lee was so helpful and is really rooting for all of his students to succeed.

Although I had much difficulty contacting Edward Lee, the TA Jesse Smith was pretty alright. The class is extremely annoying with lab notebooks being extremely bothersome and oftentimes the lab procedure didn't follow the data we recorded in the lab. Very frustrating.

Dr. Lee is truly the best! I *hated* chemistry in high school, but he has made this class so enjoyable and easy to understand. There is quite a bit of work, but once you get into the routine of what's due it's definitely easier to be prepared. Another reason why I love him is because he's extremely caring and understands when life gets in the way!
I thought Dr. Lee was a great and engaging professor, and he genuinely made class enjoyable.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is one of the best professors in Texas A&M. I'm not sure why people are giving bad reviews, but he is awesome!
Love this guy

I honestly can say Dr. Lee is one of my favorite profs. I have no clue why he gets a bad rep on here because he really is great. We watch two prerecorded lectures a week with a 2-3 question quiz after - very easy if you pay attention - and then do practice problems during class. He explains everything well and he always makes us laugh during class.

The class (CHEM117) is not that difficult, and you will most likely not often deal with Dr. Lee, as the TA runs the class. Unfortunately, if you have an issue and need to talk to him, he is the most disrespectful, unaccommodating, and unreasonable man on campus. He will not help you because he believes he's better than you for being a dept head.
I had Dr. Lee as the Gen. Chem. Lab coordinator. He was very rude to students and was not accommodating at all. He did not provide a very good experience in lab and wasn't very approachable.

Dr. Lee is not a nice guy, he gives very little respect and understanding to students. he truly does believe he holds a very high spot as the department head. He treats every student with disrespect and does not listen to their side of any story. If you have a complication with something in his class, you might as well just take the L on it.

Lee is an ok professor. He likes to laugh a lot. I thought his exams were not too bad after going to the SI sessions. He has clicker questions that are part of your grade so show up to class. And he curves at the end, which bumped me up a letter grade.

I liked Dr. Lee and enjoyed his lectures. His exams are very application heavy and he expects you to be able to put into practice what you learned. He curves every test and clicker points can boost your average. I took AP Chem in high school but still had to work extremely hard to get the grade that I did. Difficult class but overall good choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Chemistry is a difficult class, and Dr. Lee didn't make it any easier. His tests are extremely hard and only focus on a few concepts from the lectures. He doesn't give any extra credit or any ways to improve your grade. If you feel like you're going to need more teaching than just figuring it out on your own I would suggest taking someone else.

Professor Lee's class wasn't necessarily entertaining, but he was a very nice prof. If your're struggling on the homework, all you have to do is ask and he'll push the due date back. I went to A+ tutoring for extra help and still got a 72 and he rounded me up to a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dont take! I wouldnt recommend!! Hes not organized, he writes the exams a few days before. Ive gone to office hours, SIs and everything. His exams are mostly math and I personally feel theres not enough time to take his exam b/c he puts many math problems you have to solve! DONT TAKE HIM! No extra credit, no exam reviews, nothing!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I failed the final I thought I passed, so I went in to my TA's office hours. We went through every question and we agreed there's no way I got worse than a B. The TA went to talk with Dr. Lee, and when I thought the TA motioned me to come over Dr. Lee said "she cant be part of this". Rude, considering it was HIS mistake. He said he'd "look into it"

Great prof! Always helpful and encouraging when i went to his office hours. Really laid back! I definitely had to work really hard, and his tests are much more difficult than you'd expect. If you want a good grade you have to REALLY want it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I had a complication with my account and he asked me to come see him to fix the situation. When I went to see him in his office he didnt give me the time of day and was extremely rude and told me to leave without helping fixing my situation. Texas A&M should find a new department head because this guy is awful. No concern for students whatsoever
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee is honestly one of the worst profs I've ever had. He is really scatter-brained and doesn't seem to have prepared for anything before class. His tests are pretty much all math and have maybe one or two questions about concepts, so if you're not very good at math don't take him. The only good thing is he bases your grade off everyone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: After taking this chemistry course, I would not recommend it to anyone. Dr. Lee is very unprepared and pretentious. He has a "no cares" attitude and does not give any sort of test review. If it were not for the SI sessions I had with and undergraduate student outside of class (and the HOURS on end studying) then I would not have passed.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Not a very good communicator. Make sure to be specific with questions you have because this is one of those in education who probably doesnt want to be there and sees students as unimportant numbers, rather than humans trying to improve their lives through means of education. Was very rude in any interaction we had and I did not enjoy this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Lee's class was structured to be as easy as possible. He taught well, and was very clear about his expectations for students. As the Technical Lab Coordinator, it's a given that he doesn't have very much time available, but if you approach him, he will always comprehensively answer your questions. Very enjoyable class, awesome professor.

Dr. Edward Lee is literally the worst department head on campus. He is rude & sarcastic. He doesnt care for hearing you out or helping you improve your grade. He is also not available as often, & when he is, he takes his sweet time to see you.
